notes: New pixel oracle first exposed its own unmasked 32-bit luminance arithmetic; oracle corrected to the specified 8-bit Y. No RTL repair was needed.

Final original/enhancement/pixel/retro/edge cycles are bit-identical to the qualified D source.
No board test performed. Native full placement/routing is separate from these logic simulations.
